documentation.title: Confirm Passthrough
documentation.standard:
Pass the assoc args to WP_CLI::confirm() so --yes skips the prompt in CI and cron. Without them the prompt blocks every non-interactive run. An explicit guard such as "if ( ! isset( $assoc_args['yes'] ) )" around the call is accepted. Fixable: phpcbf adds the assoc-args variable as the second argument, when the call is in a command handler or in a function with a $assoc_args / $assocArgs parameter.
Requirement: E2 (MUST, error). Error codes: MissingAssocArgs.
